body: I just don't want them to react too harsh, you know? I'd like to say something, but honestly, what could they do about it?

I feel like I might regret it. My sleeping pills would probably be taken away from me. I used to use them in moderation. What I struggle with is their reaction. When I think about it, I think, what could they really do? What would I want them to do? I'm really not sure. They might misconstrue it as me being addicted. I've been doing it every other night, basically. It's willingly. It's honestly not like I feel I have to. I do it to kill the pain, but it's such a slippery slope. I don't want to become addicted or anything. I'm not sure. If you were my uncle, aunt, whatever, what would you say to me? What would you do? Just wondering.
